title: lichend open federation mode (GCP-3.2) has no enrollment path
description: Found in 3x codereview of w0fp. Gateway::admit_gateway (rust/lichen-gateway/src/gateway.rs:960-980) implements TOFU proof-of-poskey admission, but no lichend daemon config or runtime endpoint invokes it — only unit tests (gateway.rs:1951-1954). mode=open in TOML therefore unconditionally errors at startup (lichend.rs:511-514) with no way to ever enroll; deploy/lichend.toml.example documents this refusal. Implement a spec GCP-3.2 enrollment surface (daemon config trust anchors and/or a runtime CoAP enrollment resource behind existing authz), keeping the no-plaintext-fallback guarantee, and update the example docs once reachable.
